notes.note: Reviewed opt-in allowance ordering at 7ed702d912: existing authenticated credential-recovery policy route and SDK mutation preserve/clear the explicit window preference; canonical registry validates saved fields. Only same-route enrolled authorized candidates are probed, bounded to four, with post-probe admission revalidation. Provider-normalized qualified deadlines and independently fresh non-renewing subscription lifecycle observations rank only accounts meeting headroom; fresh exhaustion refuses eligibility, unknown evidence preserves ordinary order, and all-insufficient accounts refuse staging. Codex supplies qualified reset deadlines from declared seconds; current native adapters do not supply subscription-end facts and no lifecycle is inferred. Durable application/serving profile, cancellation and provider acceptance remain existing owners; this is recovery ordering, not proactive healthy-session switching. Caller integration, schema and SDK serialization tests plus deliberate reversed-order control exercised the behavior. Live independent-account comparison, proactive plugin routing and general provider commercial/lifecycle availability remain unqualified.
